instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Environmental conservation foundation managing 15 protected area and habitat restoration projects covering 25,000 hectares. Blend of scientific research, community engagement, and advocacy. Annual budget of €4M from grants and individual donations. Seeking to implement satellite-based deforestation monitoring and AI-assisted biodiversity species identification from camera trap images.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have never run a formal innovation initiative. Problems are solved ad-hoc as they arise, usually by the most directly affected team member. There is no dedicated budget, no structured ideation process, and no track record of experimenting with new technologies or business models beyond basic operational necessity.
answers.strategicGoals: Growth is our existential mandate. We are losing market share to faster-moving competitors and need to reignite our growth trajectory. We are willing to make significant strategic bets—potentially including M&A, new product lines, or geographic expansion—provided they have a credible path to meaningful revenue contribution within 18 months.
answers.additionalContext: A major new regulation (EU AI Act) comes into full effect in 18 months, directly impacting our core product which uses automated decision-making. We need to build compliance capabilities—explainability, human oversight, risk classification documentation—into our product roadmap immediately to avoid market access risk when enforcement begins.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: AI Compliance Toolkit Development
opportunities.rationale: Given the imminent EU AI Act compliance requirements, developing an explainable and risk-classified framework for our existing monitoring models is a necessary step to mitigate regulatory risk and potentially unlock new funding streams.

first_actions: Conduct a rapid workshop (1 week) with the founder to define AI classification tiers based on EU Act standards.
Identify low-cost, open-source tools for model explainability integration within existing infrastructure.
execution_plan.success_metric: Completion of a draft AI risk documentation template by Month 2.

opportunities.title: B2B Data Licensing Platform
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging the unique, high-resolution satellite data and species identification capabilities for commercial licensing (e.g., to real estate developers or pharmaceutical companies) could provide a crucial, sustainable revenue stream to meet growth targets.

first_actions: Create a minimal business case outlining data monetization strategies and target high-value licensees.
Explore partnerships with larger tech firms for potential integration or pilot testing.
resources_needed: Small marketing spend for B2B pitch materials
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure a Letter of Intent (LOI) from one commercial partner by Month 9.
milestones: Finalize Data Licensing Model and Pricing Tier (Month 4)
Launch Pilot Program with first B2B lead (Month 8)

opportunities.title: Simplified Digital Engagement Funnel
opportunities.rationale: Implementing a basic, streamlined digital communication process for community engagement can improve data collection efficiency and build the 'customer feedback' loop needed to inform future product iterations.

first_actions: Select a low-cost CRM/communication tool (e.g., simple Airtable or HubSpot free tier).
Design one core digital reporting template for community progress.
resources_needed: Founder time for setup and adoption training
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in data input efficiency by 30% through standardized forms.
milestones: Select and deploy basic communication tool (Month 2)
Achieve 50% community participation rate with new funnel (Month 6)

next_steps.action: Immediately establish a Compliance Working Group to map EU AI Act requirements against current monitoring technology.
Draft and prioritize the business case for the B2B data licensing model, focusing on minimum viable compliance standards first.
Implement a simple digital feedback form across all operational touchpoints to begin formalizing the customer experience data collection process.

key_weaknesses: Lack of formalized innovation pipeline leading to purely opportunistic problem-solving.
Low digital maturity (Level 1) severely limiting scalability and market reach.
Extreme reliance on the founder for all technical decision-making, creating a single point of failure.
Insufficient budget (€4M total) and low operational overhead making it difficult to invest in both compliance and growth initiatives simultaneously.
